text:
Maya: Heads-up — planning to onboard catalyst-5.5b-quant into the catalog today. Target smoke start 15:00 PT, pin at ~15:10. Who can cover smoke + pin readiness?

Sam: I can take the smoke at 15:00 PT. Is this a full pin or a gradual variant swap?

Maya: Full pin for the slot (catalog:catalyst-5.5b-quant:v1). Swap would be messy given quant differences. Plan: smoke 15:00-15:10, pin 15:10, monitor 15:10-15:30. Rollback window until 15:45. @ops-bot can you confirm reserved capacity?

ops-bot: Reserved slot confirmed — dc-us-west-2-gpupool-3 allocated for 15:00-15:30. Canary capacity 20% (max 40 concurrent). No conflicting pins in that slot.

Devin: Quick smoke checklist proposal:
- /health -> 200, deps ok
- small generation (sanity)
- embed similarity check sanity
- p50/p95 latency baseline vs control
- token decoding errors zero
I'll run a dry-run at 14:40.

Sam: Add: check KV cache warmup (run a few long-context prompts), and make sure batching settings default to 8 for this slot. If p95 > 250ms abort and rollback.

Maya: Copy. Smoke commands (run in staging slot then in canary):
```bash
# health
curl -sS https://inference.staging.redwood/api/v1/models/catalyst-5.5b-quant/health

# small generate
curl -sS -X POST https://inference.staging.redwood/api/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"catalyst-5.5b-quant","input":"Summarize: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog."}'

# long context warmup
curl -sS -X POST https://inference.staging.redwood/api/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"catalyst-5.5b-quant","input":"<2k tokens lorem ipsum>"}'
```

Leo: I'll watch routing, traces, and worker health during the pin. If I see worker OOMs or >5% 5xx I'll call for rollback.

Devin: Running dry-run now. Posting quick results in thread (latency, any decode errors). :thumbsup:

Sam: FYI I'll leave my pager on for the window. If everything is green on smoke, I'll execute the pin at 15:10 and post the rollout ID.

Maya: Great. Final schedule in-case timing slips:
- 14:40 dry-run (Devin)
- 15:00 smoke (Sam)
- 15:10 pin (Sam)
- 15:10-15:30 monitor (Maya/Leo)
- 15:30 assess and either keep or rollback (window til 15:45)

Maya: Tagging owners: @Sam @Devin @Leo — please ack here once you have capacity.

Sam: Ack.

Devin: Ack — results posted in 10m.

Leo: Ack, I'll be on watch.

Maya: Thanks all — will post rollout ID and smoke logs in this thread when pin starts.
